Body.Content:
This feature improves the scalability and performance of positive pay file generation by enabling the process to run as a background batch job. Organizations that generate large positive pay files can now offload processing from the interactive user session, reducing the risk of timeouts and improving the overall user experience. The enhancement is designed to support high-volume check payment scenarios while maintaining the existing positive pay functionality and output formats.

GA date: December CY2026
